title: M/s Simran Industries v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Arun Tandon, J.; Ashwani Kumar Mishra, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; relegated to Supply Code for disputed bill.
headnote: A writ against disconnection for non-payment of electricity dues is not maintainable where the consumer is dissatisfied with the amount demanded in the licensee's bill. The remedy lies under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: M/s Simran Industries of Sonpur Aklee, Ahraura, filed a writ in the Allahabad High Court against the State of U.P. and others after Purvanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited disconnected supply for non-payment of dues. The consumer was dissatisfied with the amount demanded in the licensee's bill. The petition was dismissed for non-prosecution on 6 August 2015. On 27 November 2015 the Court allowed a restoration application, recalled that order, restored the writ, and heard it the same day.

holding_units.topic: alternative remedy for disputed electricity bill
holding_units.holding: If the consumer is not satisfied with the amount demanded under a bill issued by the distribution licensee, for whatever reason, the remedy is under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and a writ petition will be dismissed.

not_decided.point: correctness of the billed demand and disconnection for non-payment
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the bill or the disconnection on merits; it relegated the consumer to the Supply Code remedy.
